     Potassium Chloride. KCL.

     The clinical symptoms of Kali chloricum (potassium chlorate) of which we have provings by Martin and Tully (See Allen's Encyclopædia, vol. 5, p. 316), are deemed sufficiently similar to those of Schuessler's Tissue Remedies to be included herein.
